parallel_groups.enter_when: The action packet and route hash are set.
parallel_groups.work: Read files that do not depend on each other in one batch. Name each file before judgment.
parallel_groups.stop_if: A needed file is missing, unfit, or still being written.

parallel_groups.enter_when: Source rights, exact questions, and search bounds are set.
parallel_groups.work: Start separate source reads early. Keep each source claim on its own.
parallel_groups.stop_if: A source needs an open right, an earlier result, or a changed question.

parallel_groups.enter_when: Product bytes, states, views, inputs, access settings, and bounds are set.
parallel_groups.work: Render and save each view form in one batch. Then run every model review.
parallel_groups.stop_if: A source or product change makes an affected image or check stale.

parallel_groups.enter_when: All pack writers are done and public bytes are set.
parallel_groups.work: Run separate read-only pack checks at the same time through Mise.
parallel_groups.stop_if: A check writes public bytes, skips a task, or reads a file still being made.

never_parallelize.rule: Finish and save the current action before the next one starts.
Never let two writers change the same run or pack file.
Do not start linked work while its intake, source, product, state, route, or view can change.
Do not save a model choice until each needed path and proof is named.

reuse.allowed: Reuse the same loaded bytes and set images inside one action batch.
reuse.forbidden: Do not reuse a prior model choice. Do not reuse an image after any input to it changes.
